title: Finished the 1st Game in the 20 Game Challenge - Key Pong!
author: CocolitoCollective
selftext:
I’m doing the 20 Game Challenge (https://20\_games\_challenge.gitlab.io/challenge/) and Pong is my first published game (ever). 

Aside from basic programming skills and tons of Udemy courses alongside YouTube, I never sat down and completed a (decent) game from start to finish. And now thanks to AI, I’m able to spend a lot more time doing it without wearing out. 

And I know “Pong is the easiest game to make” “you need AI to make a Pong Clone” while that’s true I wanted to complete it, fully. 

I used Grok to gather a clear project roadmap and Claude for the whole coding side. Before even starting I had Claude create a GDD (Game Design Document) with a clear idea of what I wanted to accomplish and the steps we would take. And I made sure to go step by step in creating “Key Pong” not asking Claude to create everything in one go. 

And since I’ve had the aspiration of becoming a game developer (ended up being a car mechanic) when I was 12, I’ve gathered tons of paid (and free) assets which saves a ton of time and headaches in generating assets. The only AI generated assets are the backgrounds. 

Anyways, I know it’s just a Pong clone, but this is a big step for me. Currently moving to Game 2 (alongside a side project creating an app for my wife). 

It’s only Browser-based - feel free to check it out https://mrcanela.itch.io/key-pong.
